target_structure.note: This is the original 450-question roadmap from the design notes. Listening/Reading are already well past target because Types 1-7 are now generated combinatorially (real synonym/pattern pairs x varied subjects, not filler) as well as rule-based (Type 2: number/time/date/money).

question_types.label: Type 6 — Sentence restructuring
question_types.source: curated + generated (unlikely->probably won't x institution combinatorics)

scaling_plan: Phase 1 (done): engine + schema + Type 2 generator (2,295 items) + curated seed set (30 items).
Phase 2 (done): combinatorial generator for Types 1,3,4,5,6,7 using real synonym/pattern pairs x varied, grammar-checked subject lists (2,645 items). Total bank: 4,970.

Phase 3: to keep growing toward 10,000 without quality loss, add more word-pairs / action-pairs / subject lists to generate-batch2.js (each new pair x existing subject lists adds ~20-25 items instantly), or add new pattern families (e.g. conditional compression, passive/active swap, before/by deadline swap).
Phase 4: add Writing Task 1/2 and Speaking modules, which need a different item shape (model answers / band-descriptor checklists) rather than the paraphrase-bank schema.
